claims.text: The hotel is at 1000 Broadway in downtown Nashville, near The Gulch and Midtown.

findings.quote: 1000 Broadway, Nashville, TN 37203, United States of America
Located near The Gulch and Midtown, our downtown hotel puts you close to a rich music scene
findings.note: Downtown location near The Gulch and Midtown confirmed.

claims.text: The hotel is steps from shopping at The Gulch, events at The Pinnacle and entertainment at Fifth + Broadway.

findings.quote: From shopping at The Gulch to events at The Pinnacle to immersive entertainment at Fifth + Broadway, you’ll be steps from it all while staying at Grand Hyatt Nashville.
findings.note: All three named attractions are covered.

claims.text: The Louisville and Nashville rail lines passed directly through the hotel's site for over a century.

findings.quote: Inspired by legendary Louisville & Nashville rail lines that passed directly through the site of the Grand Hyatt for over a century

claims.text: Rooms and suites have hardwood floors and floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: Our luxury rooms and suites feature gorgeous hardwood floors, floor-to-ceiling windows for plenty of natural light
findings.note: Both features confirmed for rooms and suites.

claims.text: Rooms include blackout curtains and Balmain bath amenities.

findings.quote: a few luxurious touches, including blackout curtains and Balmain bath amenities

claims.text: Suites offer more room and a separate living area.

findings.quote: Stay in a suite and enjoy more room and a separate living area.

claims.text: The Grand Club Lounge on the Lobby Level has an outdoor terrace overlooking downtown and serves breakfast, all-day refreshments, evening hors d'oeuvres, and beer and wine.

findings.quote: the Grand Club Lounge, located on the Lobby Level
a serene outdoor terrace overlooking the energy of downtown. Savor a curated selection of breakfast offerings, all-day refreshments, evening hors d’oeuvres, and premium beer and wine.

claims.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours, with weight equipment, cardio machines and three Pelotons.

findings.quote: Re-energize during your Nashville stay in our 24-hour fitness center, complete with weight equipment, cardio machines and three Pelotons

claims.text: The Nashville Grange on the Lobby Level serves breakfast, lunch and dinner from a 'Tennessee to table' menu, with views of Broadway and Union Station.

findings.quote: Serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, The Nashville Grange is located on the Lobby Level and features incredible views of famed Broadway, nearby Union Station and the vibrant, surrounding city.
Our “Tennessee to table” menu offers only the highest quality ingredients

claims.text: Le Petit Chef is an immersive culinary and dinner theater experience at the hotel.

findings.quote: Le Petit Chef, an immersive culinary adventure and dinner theater experience featuring regional and international delicacies.

claims.text: The hotel offers a premium single-barrel Tennessee whiskey tasting.

findings.quote: Embark on a sensory journey through the rich history of Tennessee's iconic spirit as you savor the complexities of premium single-barrel whiskey at Grand Hyatt Nashville.
findings.note: Listed under 'Experience an exclusive whiskey tasting'.

claims.text: The hotel welcomes dogs.

findings.quote: Our hotel will only allow dogs in your room or suite.
findings.note: Under 'Pets Are Welcome'; dogs are allowed.

claims.text: The rooftop venue lou/na is named for the Louisville and Nashville rail lines that once passed through the hotel's site, and has indoor and outdoor seating with views of Nashville.

findings.quote: Inspired by legendary Louisville & Nashville rail lines that passed directly through the site of the Grand Hyatt for over a century
this stunning rooftop venue that features indoor and outdoor seating, entertainment and breathtaking views of Nashville and beyond

claims.text: Gulch View rooms are on the upper floors and offer sunset views facing The Gulch.

findings.quote: Located on floors 16–22 of the hotel, this 360-square-foot room boasts one king bed, floor-to-ceiling windows, hardwood floors and sunset views facing The Gulch.
findings.note: Upper floors and sunset Gulch views confirmed.

claims.text: The heated outdoor pool and sundeck on the fifth-floor Lifestyle Level have panoramic views of downtown Nashville.

findings.quote: Soak up the season with a swim in our heated outdoor pool or relax on the sundeck, where panoramic views of downtown Nashville set the scene.
findings.note: Heated pool, sundeck and views confirmed.

findings.quote: The pool and Solstice poolside restaurant are open seasonally from early spring through late October, weather permitting, on our 5th floor Lifestyle Level.

claims.text: The R+R Wellness spa's name stands for Recharge and Replenish and pays homage to the Nashville Yards railroad region.

findings.quote: Paying homage to the culture of downtown’s Nashville Yards and railroad region, R+R stands for Recharge and Replenish.

claims.text: The June Presidential Suite is on the top floor and looks out over the Nashville skyline.

findings.quote: Enjoy the sweeping Nashville skyline in this 1,550-square-foot suite with spacious seating and dining areas and a bedroom with a king bed. Located on the top floor of the hotel, this is a premium suite.
findings.note: Top floor and skyline views confirmed.

claims.text: The outdoor pool is open seasonally from early spring through late October, weather permitting.

findings.quote: The pool and Solstice poolside restaurant are open seasonally from early spring through late October, weather permitting

claims.text: Grand Club Lounge access is for guests of Club Access rooms and suites and select World of Hyatt tiers.

findings.quote: Access to the Grand Club Lounge is reserved exclusively for registered guests of Club Access rooms and suites, as well as select World of Hyatt tiers.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting may bring typical downtown noise levels.
